summary: Cycle 2 resumed from a quota-halted dispatch: recovered ~364 lines of stashed WIP (git stash pop, clean), fixed one outstanding build error in outDegEq's proof (a match-auxiliary-constant identity issue between two lemmas' rw targets, resolved via term-mode Eq.trans/congrArg composition instead of rw), and landed accFresh/accKnown/outDegEq (Phase 4, now 4/6 fields) plus the full Phase 6 pigeonhole world bound (modalKnownWorlds_length_le_worldBoundS5, static, no step-preservation reasoning). Investigated closing Phase 4's remaining bClosure/eClosure fields using the new pigeonhole bound and found a genuine additional gap: the pigeonhole bound only bounds the COUNT of known worlds, but bClosure/eClosure's mint case needs a bound on the VALUE of the freshly-minted world label, which requires an as-yet-unproven contiguous-world-numbering invariant not present anywhere in the codebase. This is documented precisely (with a concrete recommended fix: a 12th S5LoopInv field) rather than rushed with sorry or a vacuous placeholder. Phase 7 (soundness bridge) not attempted this dispatch.

blockers.description: bClosure/eClosure BLOCKED on a missing contiguity invariant connecting modalMaxWorld b's numeric value to (modalKnownWorlds b).length. Phase 6's pigeonhole bound (landed this dispatch) only bounds the COUNT of known worlds; placing a freshly-minted formula (label modalNextWorld b) into modalUniverseS5 phi0 needs a bound on modalNextWorld b's VALUE, which requires world labels to form a contiguous range {0,...,modalMaxWorld b} with no gaps -- true for this driver (worlds are only minted at exactly modalMaxWorld b + 1) but not yet a proven, threaded invariant. Confirmed via grep across FmpMeasure.lean/LoopChecking.lean/S5Simplification.lean/GenericDriver.lean that only a one-directional per-element bound (modalKnownWorlds_le_modalMaxWorld) exists, not the needed count<->value connection.
